pages.title: Border Blocks
pages.text: Not to be confused with $(l:border_stones#border_stones)Border Stones$(/l)$().$(br)Border blocks are display blocks used to show a Parcel's boundaries. They appear like solid lines forming a box around the area.

pages.title: Buffer Blocks
pages.text: Buffer blocks are display blocks used to show a Parcel's buffer boundaries. They extend further out from the borders. They represent the the minimum distance between parcels. A Parcel's border cannot overlap another Parcel's buffer.$(br)Note: Buffers can overlap each other.
